## Change contract

- [ ] Scope and affected `UI-*`, `OBJ-*`, `DAT-*`, `MET-*`, `AUD-*` or decision IDs are identified.
- [ ] Synthetic/public-safe boundary is preserved; no real candidate data, credential or production endpoint is present.
- [ ] Role, row and field authorization effects are covered by negative as well as positive tests.
- [ ] Metric grain, numerator, denominator, N/A behavior and source are updated where applicable.
- [ ] Accessibility states, failure/retry/cancel/recovery and audit/version behavior are covered.
- [ ] PRD, matrix and contracts are reconciled; open external gates remain explicitly open.
- [ ] `pnpm verify` and `pnpm test:e2e` pass.

## Evidence

Describe the result, test output, screenshots/recordings where useful, risks, rollback and any approval still required.
